ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the top of a building is equipped with a billboard CD. Xiao Ming measures the angle of elevation to the bottom of the billboard D to be $60^\circ$ at point A at the foot of the hill. While walking up the hill to point B, he measures the angle of elevation to the top of the billboard C to be $45^\circ$. Given that the slope angle of AB is $30^\circ$, $AB=10$ meters, and $AE=15$ meters, what is the height of the billboard CD? (in meters)
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Draw perpendicular lines from point B to AE and DE, with the perpendicular feet being G and F, respectively, as shown in the diagram. \\
In right triangle $\triangle ABG$, $\angle BAG=30^\circ$ \\
$\therefore BG=\frac{1}{2}AB=5$ meters, $AG=AB\cdot \cos 30^\circ=10\times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}=5\sqrt{3}$ (meters) \\
$\therefore EG=AG+AE=(5\sqrt{3}+15)$ meters \\
$\because BG\perp AE$, $BF\perp ED$, $AE\perp ED$ \\
$\therefore$ Quadrilateral BGEF is a rectangle. \\
$\therefore EF=BG=5$ meters, $BF=EG=(5\sqrt{3}+15)$ meters \\
$\because \angle CBF=45^\circ$, $BF\perp ED$ \\
$\therefore \angle BCF=\angle CBF=45^\circ$ \\
$\therefore CF=BF=(5\sqrt{3}+15)$ meters \\
In right triangle $\triangle DAE$, $\angle DAE=60^\circ$, AE=15 meters \\
$\therefore DE=AE\cdot \tan\angle DAE=15\sqrt{3}$(meters) \\
$\therefore CD=CF+EF−DE=5\sqrt{3}+15+5−15\sqrt{3}=\boxed{20−10\sqrt{3}}$ meters

method.method_draft: Use direct height decomposition with horizontal distances. From the figure, C and D are on the same vertical line through E, so CD equals the top height above ground minus the bottom height above ground. The bottom of the billboard has height DE=AE·tan60°=15√3. For the top C viewed from B, first resolve B relative to A: B is 10 sin30°=5 m above the ground line AE, and horizontally 10 cos30°=5√3 m farther left than A. Therefore the horizontal distance from B to the building line through E is AE+5√3=15+5√3. Since the elevation angle from B to C is 45°, the vertical rise from B to C is (15+5√3)tan45°=15+5√3. method.CoT_raw:

再推理：以 A 所在水平地面为基准，D 的离地高度为 DE=AE·tan60°=15√3。由 AB=10 且坡角为 30°，B 相对 A 的竖直升高为 10sin30°=5，水平向左位移为 10cos30°=5√3。所以 B 到建筑物竖直线的水平距离为 AE+5√3=15+5√3。因为从 B 到 C 的仰角是 45°，所以 C 相对 B 的竖直升高为 (15+5√3)tan45°=15+5√3。因此 C 的离地高度为 5+(15+5√3)=20+5√3。广告牌高度 CD 等于 C 的离地高度减去 D 的离地高度：CD=(20+5√3)-15√3=20-10√3。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, the top of a building is equipped with a billboard CD. Xiao Ming measures the angle of elevation to the bottom of the billboard D to be $60^\circ$ at point A at the foot of the hill. While walking up the hill to point B, he measures the angle of elevation to the top of the billboard C to be $45^\circ$. Given that the slope angle of AB is $30^\circ$, $AB=10$ meters, and $AE=15$ meters, what is the height of the billboard CD? (in meters)
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} Draw perpendicular lines from point B to AE and DE, with the perpendicular feet being G and F, respectively, as shown in the diagram. \\
In right triangle $\triangle ABG$, $\angle BAG=30^\circ$ \\
$\therefore BG=\frac{1}{2}AB=5$ meters, $AG=AB\cdot \cos 30^\circ=10\times \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}=5\sqrt{3}$ (meters) \\
$\therefore EG=AG+AE=(5\sqrt{3}+15)$ meters \\
$\because BG\perp AE$, $BF\perp ED$, $AE\perp ED$ \\
$\therefore$ Quadrilateral BGEF is a rectangle. \\
$\therefore EF=BG=5$ meters, $BF=EG=(5\sqrt{3}+15)$ meters \\
$\because \angle CBF=45^\circ$, $BF\perp ED$ \\
$\therefore \angle BCF=\angle CBF=45^\circ$ \\
$\therefore CF=BF=(5\sqrt{3}+15)$ meters \\
In right triangle $\triangle DAE$, $\angle DAE=60^\circ$, AE=15 meters \\
$\therefore DE=AE\cdot \tan\angle DAE=15\sqrt{3}$(meters) \\
$\therefore CD=CF+EF−DE=5\sqrt{3}+15+5−15\sqrt{3}=\boxed{20−10\sqrt{3}}$ meters
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: In the figure, AE is the horizontal ground line, A is on the left, E is on the right; upward through E is the vertical side of the building, D is at a lower place, C is above D, and CD represents the height of the billboard. The angle between the line of sight from A to D and the horizontal AE is marked as 60°; B is located on the slope at the upper left of A, and the angle between the line of sight from B to C and the horizontal dashed line is marked as 45°. The problem gives AB=10 m, slope AB makes 30° with the horizontal, AE=15 m.
Then reason: By the coordinate method, take A=(0,0), AE as the x-axis, E=(15,0), and the straight line where the building and billboard are located as x=15. Because B moves from A along the slope toward the upper left, and AB=10, the slope angle is 30°, so B=(-10cos30°, 10sin30°)=(-5√3, 5). The angle of elevation from A to D is 60°, and D is on x=15, therefore y_D=15tan60°=15√3. The angle of elevation from B to C is 45°, so the slope of line BC is tan45°=1. The horizontal distance from B to x=15 is 15-(-5√3)=15+5√3, therefore y_C=5+(15+5√3)=20+5√3. The billboard height CD=y_C-y_D=(20+5√3)-15√3=20-10√3 meters.
